description: You are a backend engineer at a startup. A PM has requested a new feature: 'Add data validation when users import CSV files - check for required columns, valid email formats, date ranges, etc. How big of a lift is this?' Your task: Explore the analytics_platform codebase at /home/ga/workspace/analytics_platform and create a scope document at /home/ga/workspace/analytics_platform/SCOPE_CSV_VALIDATION.md. The document MUST include these sections: (1) Feature Summary, (2) Current Implementation Analysis - describe how CSV import currently works and which files/functions are involved, (3) Affected Components - list at least 3 specific files that need modification and explain why, (4) Data Model Review - list validation requirements for fields: timestamp, user_email, value, category based on models.py, (5) Proposed Validation Rules - specific checks needed (required columns, email format, date parsing, numeric validation, etc), (6) Dependencies & Libraries - check requirements.txt and suggest validation libraries, (7) Integration Points - where validation should be called, (8) Edge Cases & Risks - identify at least 3 potential issues, (9) Testing Considerations, (10) Effort Estimate - complexity and time estimate, (11) Implementation Phases. DO NOT modify any code files - this is analysis only. Save the document when complete.
